title: Reflect on Your Negotiation
subtitle: Take a few minutes to review your transcript and answer the following questions. There are no right or wrong answers.
instruction: Read through your conversation transcript on the left, then respond to each prompt below.

prompts.question: Identify one moment where your response could have been better.
prompts.placeholder: Describe the moment (e.g., when you said X, or when the counterpart said Y)...

prompts.question: What did you do in that moment?
prompts.placeholder: Describe what you said or did...

prompts.question: Why do you think it did not go well?
prompts.placeholder: What were you thinking at that point? Why did you respond that way?...

prompts.question: What would you do differently next time?
prompts.placeholder: If you could replay that moment, what would you say or do instead?...

prompts.question: What is one takeaway for future negotiations?
prompts.placeholder: What is one thing you will try to do differently in your next negotiation?...

note: ⚠️ Group B only. Content from experiment_design.md — not yet confirmed by professor.
